Nobody tells you November is still garlic planting time

I break up garlic bulbs just before planting the largest outer cloves from October to November. If you want to know how to grow garlic in the UK, put them in full sun and keep the bed weed-free. Dry the harvested bulbs for 2 to 3 weeks and softneck types can keep for 6 to 9 months.

Check your local frost dates.

2 ways to use up spring onions before they go to waste

If you are wondering what to do with too many spring onions, I cook them briefly in stir-fries, omelettes or noodle dishes. You can also chop and freeze them in bags, or pickle them in a light vinegar brine to last one to two months in the fridge. Best of all, put the roots in a glass of water on a windowsill to regrow them.

Check your local frost dates.

posts.text:
Too many Brussels sprouts? Don't bin them

If you are wondering what to do with too many Brussels sprouts, start with how you cook them. I like to roast them with olive oil and balsamic vinegar for a caramelised flavour. You can also boil or steam whole sprouts for six to eight minutes. That way, nothing from your harvest gets wasted.

Check your local frost dates.

Full guide on homegrownplate.co.uk/plants/brussels-sprouts/

Save this for when you need it.
